subject: mathematics
content:
Let the lines

$$\frac{x-1}{\lambda}=\frac{y-2}{1}=\frac{z-3}{2}$$ and

$$\frac{x+26}{-2}=\frac{y+18}{3}=\frac{z+28}{\lambda}$$ be coplanar

and $$\mathrm{P}$$ be the plane containing these two lines.

Then which of the following points does NOT lie on P?
